description: Exact symmetry-quotient certificate for the full pinned RM(2,5) local projection-marginal model through level 8.
verification_notes: The primal vector assigns one mass to every variable in each symmetry orbit; every quotient equality is checked exactly over rationals.
The lower bound is inherited from the exact affine-overlap submodel: every full-level feasible point projects to that submodel.
The full model includes every coordinate scope of size at most 8, exact pinned-code projection support, and every containment marginal.
This resolves the finite level-8 relaxation value only; it is not a SAT algorithm or a P-versus-NP result.
